primary.interpretation: No evidence of a bug-yield benefit in this short run; five pairs and approximately 4.5 CPU seconds per arm are much too small to infer equal long-run effectiveness.

secondary.measure: successful query pairs from fully completed 200-attempt databases before CPU stop
secondary.interpretation: Suggestive operational proxy only; mixed signs and weak paired evidence after balancing arm order. Not a bug-finding result.

integrity.source_logger_failure_log_pattern: logs/general/<database>.log; rolling *-cur.log is not a bug candidate

research_decision: Down-rank feedback guidance as a scientific-discovery lead. Retain only the previously observed narrow query-throughput proxy; do not claim distinct bug yield or a research breakthrough. A substantially longer, preregistered bug-yield campaign is required if this direction is revisited.
